data.name: VSG_001
data.value: The mist is even thicker here...[pause=15] It's almost unreal.

data.name: VSG_002
data.value: This is the heart of the steppe.[pause=20] Something must be protecting this place.

data.name: VSG_003
data.value: Its antlers...[pause=10] they're glowing!

data.name: VSG_004
data.value: The Warden of the Plains awakens...

data.name: VSG_005
data.value: That voice again!

data.name: VSG_006
data.value: The strongest of the herd.[pause=20] He will not yield so easily.

data.name: VSG_007
data.value: Prove your worth, traveler...

data.name: VSG_008
data.value: This is the last obstacle before the end of the steppe![pause=10] Let's go!

data.name: VSG_009
data.value: We're charging back in.[pause=15] This time, we've got this!

data.name: VSG_010
data.value: We defeated the guardian of the steppe!

data.name: VSG_011
data.value: The mist is starting to clear...

data.name: VSG_012
data.value: That voice...[pause=15] It knew he was here.

data.name: VSG_013
data.value: We'll find answers later.[pause=20] Let's move forward.

data.name: VSG_014
data.value: The Warden shows no mercy to the weak.

data.name: VSG_015
data.value: Go back where you came from.[pause=30] Return when you are ready.

data.name: VSG_016
data.value: We...[pause=10] we can't do this![pause=15] He's too powerful!

data.name: VSG_017
data.value: The Warden lowers its head.[pause=20] Its antlers emit one last glow.

data.name: VSG_018
data.value: You are not ready yet, traveler.[pause=30] But you have heart.

data.name: VSG_019
data.value: The Alpha watches you leave without moving.[pause=25] It returns to watching over the steppe.

data.name: VSG_020
data.value: The Warden collapses with a deep rumble.[pause=15] The mist around him dissipates.

data.name: VSG_021
data.value: Its antlers fade slowly.[pause=20] It looks at you with... respect?

data.name: VSG_022
data.value: You are worthy, stranger.[pause=25] The steppe is yours.

data.name: VSG_023
data.value: It vanishes into the mist, leaving behind a peaceful silence.

data.name: VSG_024
data.value: We defeated the Warden...[pause=15] We really did it.

data.name: VSG_025
data.value: Even the greatest wardens eventually bow.[pause=25] You are progressing.
